title: ever LARK|Ruffles Sleeve Pleated V-Neck A-Line Midi Chiffon Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your style with our Ruffles Sleeve Pleated V-Neck A-Line Midi Chiffon Wedding Guest Dress. The delicate ruffled sleeves and pleated detailing add a touch of romance to this enchanting midi dress. The flattering A-line silhouette and V-neck create a timeless and sophisticated look. Crafted in chiffon, this dress is perfect for wedding guests who desire both elegance and comfort.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length:Tea length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
